description: This file contains C source code implementing WiFi event handling functions, including creation, cloning, destruction, copying, and queuing of WiFi events and monitor responses. It manages event lifecycle and messaging between components in a WiFi management system.

methods.name: void free_cloned_event(wifi_event_t * clone)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a cloned WiFi event.

methods.name: int clone_wifi_event(wifi_event_t * event,wifi_event_t ** clone)
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an existing WiFi event, handling different event types and associated message copying.

methods.name: wifi_event_t * create_wifi_event(unsigned int msg_len,wifi_event_type_t type,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new WiFi event structure based on the specified message length, type, and subtype.

methods.name: wifi_event_t * create_wifi_monitor_response_event(const void * msg,unsigned int msg_len,wifi_event_type_t type,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type)
methods.description: Creates a WiFi event specifically for monitor responses, including allocation and initialization of response-specific data structures.

methods.name: void destroy_wifi_event(wifi_event_t * event)
methods.description: Releases all memory associated with a WiFi event, including nested data depending on event type.

methods.name: int copy_msg_to_event(const void * data,unsigned int msg_len,wifi_event_type_t type,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type,wifi_event_route_t * rt,wifi_event_t * event)
methods.description: Copies message data into a WiFi event structure, setting event type and subtype, and handling different message formats based on event type.

methods.name: int push_monitor_response_event_to_ctrl_queue(const void * msg,unsigned int len,wifi_event_type_t type,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type,wifi_event_route_t * rt)
methods.description: Enqueues a monitor response event into the control queue for processing.

methods.name: int push_event_to_ctrl_queue(const void * msg,unsigned int len,wifi_event_type_t type,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type,wifi_event_route_t * rt)
methods.description: Enqueues a general WiFi event into the control queue for processing.

methods.name: int push_event_to_monitor_queue(wifi_monitor_data_t * mon_data,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type,wifi_event_route_t * rt)
methods.description: Enqueues a monitor data event into the monitor-specific queue for processing.
